mapper.select: SELECT id, scheme_id AS schemeId, version_id AS versionId, inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, sampling_amount AS samplingAmount, sampling_unit AS samplingUnit, sampling_count AS samplingCount FROM lm_inspection_scheme_sampling WHERE scheme_id = #{schemeId} and version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY create_time ASC

select *, lm_inspect_item.name as inspectItemName, lm_inspect_item.code as inspectItemCode from lm_inspection_scheme_sampling left join lm_inspect_item on lm_inspect_item.id = lm_inspection_scheme_sampling.inspect_item_id where scheme_id = #{schemeId} and version_id = #{versionId} and lm_inspection_scheme_sampling.is_deleted = 0 order by lm_inspection_scheme_sampling.create_time ASC
